digest.component_or_area: LLM auth injection and ProviderSession integration
propositions: Add typed provider-specific LLMRuntime auth/session capabilities in src/rebar/llm/auth.py that remain non-serializable and outside config/cache/schema/output boundaries
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to accept LLMRuntime and pass it into the single per-run ProviderSession builder without forking the RP-01 authorization path

Ensure provider-native auth capabilities (boto3 Session, Anthropic token provider, OpenAI workload identity) reach only the existing ProviderSession builder and exactly one Rebar-owned official client lifecycle
Fail fast before a provider model request if explicit auth is missing or conflicting, without fallback to anonymous or alternate principals
Preserve all RP-01 policies including request budget, output repair, cache, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, and failure behavior unchanged
Ensure credential material is absent from config, request, snapshot, fingerprint, cache, schema, output, logs, exceptions, and tracing boundaries
